assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: landscape editorial cover illustration for a Chinese science blog about Johnson criteria, optical/infrared imaging and camouflage evaluation. Create a sophisticated original wide 16:9 cover, ideally 1536x864 or similar wide composition. Scene: a subtle camouflaged geometric object blends into an atmospheric woodland landscape on the left; a beautifully rendered optical lens near the center transforms that scene into a small luminous pixel sampling plane on the right. Convey the transition from natural scene to optical information, with elegant fine ray lines and restrained grayscale alternating spatial-frequency bars, plus a small muted amber thermal-imaging motif integrated naturally. Illustration, not a scientific measurement or literal ray-tracing diagram. High quality editorial art mixing soft painterly woodland textures and crisp optical glass, restrained plum and teal accents consistent with a soft science blog. Strong simple visual focal point, generous breathing room, quiet thoughtful mood. Keep all essential subject matter in the central 70 percent for cover cropping. No text, no numbers, no formulas, no logos, no watermarks, no guns, no crosshair, no targeting HUD, no extra decorative charts. Opaque background.
assets.note: Conceptual cover art; not a measured thermal image or accurate ray-tracing diagram. Generated original copied into project without editing.
Ideal alternating bars and uniform pixel-area integration at two samples per cycle; not an observer-performance experiment.
Paraxial projection; target distance and focal length not drawn to scale.
Illustrative grayscale modulation and noise only; not measured MTF or NETD.
Physical features, imaging conditions and task evaluation are distinct. Conceptual relationship, not a validated performance model.
